utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’ll keep it low-key and let folks know the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and I can help line up a few volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds great, Vik — thanks for lining that up. Just let me know where you’d like me to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you’re definitely able to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes — I can help with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — yes, it’s now Sunday at the community center. If you can help spread the word or line up a few volunteers, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll keep it low-key and help spread the word, and I can try to line up a few volunteers too. What’s the best way to share it?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what repair supplies we already have and what we still need for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be a huge help, Cleo—thank you! I’m hearing we’ve got a nice start, but we still might need a few odds and ends.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center now, and I’m still gathering the final details. If you can help spread the word, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Faye — Sunday at the community center works, and I’ll wait for the final details before I pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Opal — keep it low-key, and I can help a little with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye on where the repair drive is set up and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Dane — I’ll keep the repair drive low-key and organized.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks — what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be really helpful, Jules — if you can keep an eye out for what we’re still missing, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort the drop-off times and who’s bringing what? I’m trying to keep the repair drive from getting chaotic.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I can help sort the drop-off times and who’s bringing what. Send me the list of what’s left, and I’ll get it organized.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Gus — I’ll keep everyone posted about the Sunday repair drive at the community center, and I’d love your tools and help if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Quinn — I’m free and happy to bring a few tools. Just let me know what you still need for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I still need to check what’s left on the repair drive list. I skimmed it, but I’m not sure what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Bo. Once you check the list, let me know what’s still needed and I’ll keep an eye out for the repair drive setup.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What still needs fixing for the repair drive, and do we already have the supplies?
